style: Photorealistic commercial photography, premium advertising quality, 85mm lens, soft natural key light with believable contact shadows, real material textures and specular highlights, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain. Strictly NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO watermark, NO emoji, NO cartoon, NO illustration, NO sticker or stamp look, NO plastic CGI look.

key.tpl: Vertical 2:3 key visual for a mobile game. The hero subject is large (about 60% of the frame), placed slightly below center. Leave the top 25% of the frame calm and uncluttered for a title overlay. Subject: {subject}

bg.tpl: Vertical 2:3 background plate for gameplay. The hero object is NOT present. The central 50% of the frame stays calm and uncluttered so game objects can move over it. Scene: {subject}

hero.tpl: One single isolated object, fully visible with generous margin, centered, no cropping. Transparent background (alpha PNG). If transparency is not supported, use a pure flat white #FFFFFF background and no floor shadow. Subject: {subject}

item.tpl: One single isolated object, fully visible with generous margin, centered, no cropping. Transparent background (alpha PNG). If transparency is not supported, use a pure flat white #FFFFFF background and no floor shadow. Subject: {subject}

result.tpl: Landscape 3:2 photograph of an absurd-but-photorealistic outcome, shot like a serious news photo. Keep the center-left calm for a score overlay. Scene: {subject}

hand.tpl: One single isolated object, fully visible with generous margin, centered, no cropping. Transparent background (alpha PNG). If transparency is not supported, use a pure flat white #FFFFFF background and no floor shadow. Subject: {subject}
